about: You doing your own score math, 5 bits: 1) "maybe we'll be on in four… I'm actually gonna be pissed if we're not on in four to be honest" → the approach shot → "so as it turns out, I'm pissed" 2) "absolutely pissing rain today, but I've got to break 100, so no days off" 3) "I think this is only my fifth or sixth stroke, but it feels like I've been playing this hole for an hour" 4) short putts → "honestly, a four putt is pretty standard, but that long putt, incredible" 5) bunker shot → "perfect, perfect. I've lost track of the score, it doesn't even matter, all that matters is being loosey goosey". Every shot kept whole, no swearing cut, no shirt wipes. Outfits alternate (white/camo → blue rain polo → green cactus day → orange checker → green polo). All already-posted footage (the cactus par 5 full went up this morning). 45 s, full-quality export from your originals.
